`class ResourcePlayerNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.resource` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ResourcePlayerNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/resource/ResourcePlayerNode.java)

Plays a video or an animated image in its bounds, with its sound, and controls the playback.

![An animated image: a grey square slides from left to right](/captures/catalog-nodes-resourceplayernode.webp)

## Description

Each player plays its own copy of the resource, made when the node is attached, so two players of the same resource play separately.
Before that copy exists, `play`, `pause`, `stop`, `restart` and `seek` are kept and applied when the playback starts; `getPlayback()` and `getVideo()` return `null`.
The node waits for its resource like a [`ResourceNode`](/reference/nodes/resourcenode/) and takes its size the same way.

- [Images and media](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/media/#play-animated-images-and-videos)
- [Show a video](/use/guides/show-a-video/)

## Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [resource](#ResourcePlayerNode-property-resource) <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span> | [`Resource`](/reference/resources/resource/) | `null` | The video or animated image to play. |
| [stretch](#ResourcePlayerNode-property-stretch) <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span> | [`StretchType`](/reference/nodes/resourcenode-stretchtype/) | `StretchType.STRETCH` | How the frames fill the bounds. |

## Events

| Event | Listener | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [onPlay](#ResourcePlayerNode-event-onPlay) | [`EventListener<NodeEvent<T>>`](/reference/events/nodeevent/) | Adds a listener that runs when the playback starts or resumes. |
| [onPause](#ResourcePlayerNode-event-onPause) | [`EventListener<NodeEvent<T>>`](/reference/events/nodeevent/) | Adds a listener that runs when the playback pauses. |
| [onStop](#ResourcePlayerNode-event-onStop) | [`EventListener<NodeEvent<T>>`](/reference/events/nodeevent/) | Adds a listener that runs when the playback stops, by `stop()` or at the end of a resource that does not loop. |
| [onEnd](#ResourcePlayerNode-event-onEnd) | [`EventListener<NodeEvent<T>>`](/reference/events/nodeevent/) | Adds a listener that runs when a resource that does not loop reaches its end, before `onStop`. |
| [onProgress](#ResourcePlayerNode-event-onProgress) | [`EventListener<NodeProgressEvent<T>>`](/reference/events/nodeprogressevent/) | Adds a listener that runs on every frame where the progress changes, with the progress and the current time. |

### resource

The video or animated image to play.

The playback of the copy that this node plays, or `null` before the node is attached or when the resource has none.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-getVideo"></a>

### getVideo

`VideoResourceDecoder getVideo()` 

The video decoder of the copy that this node plays, or `null` when the resource is not a video or the node is not attached.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-isPaused"></a>

### isPaused

`boolean isPaused()` 

If `true`, the playback is paused.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-isPlaying"></a>

### isPlaying

`boolean isPlaying()` 

If `true`, the playback is playing.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-play"></a>

### play

`this play()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Starts the playback, or resumes it after a pause or a stop; `onPlay` fires on the next frame, once the playback runs.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when the resource has no playback, such as a still image.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-stop"></a>

### stop

`this stop()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Stops the playback, back at the start, and fires `onStop`.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-pause"></a>

### pause

`this pause()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Pauses a playing resource and fires `onPause`.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-toggle"></a>

### toggle

`this toggle()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Pauses a playing resource, otherwise plays it.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-restart"></a>

### restart

`this restart()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Plays the resource again from the start.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-seek"></a>

### seek

`this seek(double seconds)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Moves the playback to this time, in seconds.
A stopped resource pauses at that time and shows its frame.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-update"></a>

### update

`void update()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Measures the resource on every frame, so that the node takes its size as soon as it loads.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-draw"></a>

### draw

`void draw(double mouseX, double mouseY)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Starts the playback on the first frame, fires the playback events, then draws the current frame.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-method-detach"></a>

### detach

`void detach()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Releases the copy that this node plays and its sound; attaching the node again starts from the beginning.

## Event details

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-event-onPlay"></a>

### onPlay

`this onPlay(EventListener<NodeEvent<T>> listener)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Adds a listener that runs when the playback starts or resumes.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-event-onPause"></a>

### onPause

`this onPause(EventListener<NodeEvent<T>> listener)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Adds a listener that runs when the playback pauses.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-event-onStop"></a>

### onStop

`this onStop(EventListener<NodeEvent<T>> listener)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Adds a listener that runs when the playback stops, by `stop()` or at the end of a resource that does not loop.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-event-onEnd"></a>

### onEnd

`this onEnd(EventListener<NodeEvent<T>> listener)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Adds a listener that runs when a resource that does not loop reaches its end, before `onStop`.

<a id="ResourcePlayerNode-event-onProgress"></a>

### onProgress

`this onProgress(EventListener<NodeProgressEvent<T>> listener)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Adds a listener that runs on every frame where the progress changes, with the progress and the current time.

---

<small>`fluent` returns the instance, typed for chaining · `factory` creates an instance · `signal` also accepts a value that follows signals, as a signal, an expression or a lambda ([When does JOID compute this value again?](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/#ask-when-does-joid-compute-this-value-again)) · `hook` called by JOID, override it · `abstract` you implement it · `default` interface method with a body · `static` called on the class · `protected` visible to subclasses</small>
